title: schedonorus littoreus
intro: Schedonorus littoreus, commonly known as Wheat Grass, is a type of young grass from the wheat plant that is harvested before it reaches maturity. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Wheat Grass are attributed to its ability to promote antioxidant activity, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Wheat Grass include chlorophyll, vitamins, minerals, and other phytochemicals that contribute to its medicinal properties.
